notes.title: Adjustments to Unity's reflection function
notes.content:
For those of you who are fans of "Hop Step Sing!", the build that includes adjustments for the Unity version upgrade was released on June 28.

The problem with the reflection has been fixed, so why don't you take this opportunity to revisit "KISEKITEKI SHINING!"

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]]
[*] Due to Unity's version upgrade, the reflection function no longer works well with some headsets, so we've removed the relevant function.
[/list]

If you'd like to enjoy some of the other songs, or just want to see them live, be sure to check out "HopSummer 2020"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574470/Hop_Step_Sing_VR_Live_HopSummer_Tour_2020/
